text.tspan: Only in an internal market emergency; priority orders,
Market surveillance of machinery and other CE-marked
products. A machine under the Machinery Directive (listed in
Art. 4(5) MSR) may be placed on the market only with an
economic operator established in the Union who answers to
the authorities (Art. 4 MSR), also for online sales. To be
merged into the European Product Act.

marking, conformity assessment, digital product information.
